description: Get runtime information about the Studio NEO V2 process: game/engine versions, plugin status and whether a Studio scene is loaded. Works even before the Studio scene is ready. 'plugins' reports the optional third-party plugins Miraneo bridges to — check it before using the studio_timeline_* tools, which are always listed but fail when their plugin is absent.

game_version.description: content of the game-root version file

plugins.description: optional plugins Miraneo bridges to, name to version, or null when not installed

timeline.description: Timeline (joan6694) version, e.g. '1.4.1'; null when absent
